title: BUILD-NRT-065-source-ownership-and-refresh-cadence
universal_lens: The NFL roster truth system is modeled as a directed acyclic graph of evidence nodes, where each fact is a weighted edge. Source ownership defines node provenance, while refresh cadence dictates temporal decay functions. Reconciliation acts as a projection operator mapping heterogeneous source manifolds into a unified canonical state space.
gsi_mapping: GSI treats roster facts as latent variables inferred from noisy multi-source observations. Bayesian updating occurs upon new official evidence ingestion, adjusting posterior probabilities for team and status assignments. Conformal prediction intervals bound the uncertainty of stale or conflicting records, ensuring robust downstream statistical inference.
gse_mapping: In GSE, roster accuracy dictates valid state transitions within the situational reasoning engine. A player's verified team and active status define the permissible action space. The reconciliation plan acts as a constraint solver, vetoing invalid game states if foundational identity primitives are corrupted or unresolved.

The derivation of the roster truth system begins by defining the state space of an NFL entity as a vector of atomic facts (team, number, status). We model the ingestion of external data as a stochastic process generating noisy observations of this true state. The 'official evidence consensus' operator acts as a maximum a posteriori (MAP) estimator, heavily weighting observations from authoritative sources (e.g., NFL.com) over open-data proxies. However, information degrades over time; thus, we introduce a temporal decay function tied to the refresh cadence. If the delta between the snapshot timestamp and the current evaluation time exceeds a threshold, the confidence interval of the fact widens, eventually triggering a 'stale' flag. The 'fact-by-fact reconciliation' projects these multi-source observations onto a unified manifold. When projections disagree, the system does not arbitrarily overwrite but instead elevates the conflict to an internal visibility layer, preventing silent corruption. This mathematical structure ensures that the Player Lab and GSE Rating systems consume only rigorously bounded, temporally relevant truths. Failure modes arise when official sources themselves issue contradictory updates simultaneously, creating a singularity in the consensus operator that requires manual intervention or higher-order tie-breaking rules.
